_about: The lines of «Файлы с Mac…» (sim-app): what the copy from the Mac's folder did or why nothing (more) was copied. {path} — the folder's path, {name} — the name as the registry writes it, {found} and {bytes} — sizes, {count} — files, {gb} — gigabytes.
hash: файл не тот: {name} — sha256 не сходится
done: файлы с Mac на месте: {count}, {gb} ГБ
nolist: в папке нет manifest.json — сначала python3 scripts/mac_files.py
